versions.stem: Zinc metal is obtained from sulfide ores. The most common ore of zinc is sphalerite, which contains zinc sulfide (ZnS) and a small amount of cadmium sulfide (CdS). The stages involved in the extraction of zinc from sphalerite are: Stage1 Sphalerite is strongly heated in air. $2 \mathrm {Z n S} (\mathrm {s}) + 3 \mathrm {O} _ {2} (\mathrm {g}) \rightarrow 2 \mathrm {Z n O} (\mathrm {s}) + 2 \mathrm {S O} _ {2} (\mathrm {g})$ $2 \mathrm {C d S} (\mathrm {s}) + 3 \mathrm {O} _ {2} (\mathrm {g}) \rightarrow 2 \mathrm {C d O} (\mathrm {s}) + 2 \mathrm {S O} _ {2} (\mathrm {g})$ Stage 2 The mixture of oxides is reacted with sulfuric acid. $\mathrm {Z n O (s)} + \mathrm {H} _ {2} \mathrm {S O} _ {4} (\mathrm {a q}) \rightarrow \mathrm {Z n S O} _ {4} (\mathrm {a q}) + \mathrm {H} _ {2} \mathrm {O} (\mathrm {I})$ $\mathrm {C d O (s)} + \mathrm {H} _ {2} \mathrm {S O} _ {4} (\mathrm {a q}) \rightarrow \mathrm {C d S O} _ {4} (\mathrm {a q}) + \mathrm {H} _ {2} \mathrm {O (l)}$ Stage 3 Zinc dust is added to the solution containing zinc sulfate and cadmium sulfate to remove the cadmium ions. $\mathrm {C d} ^ {2 +} (\mathrm {a q}) + \mathrm {Z n} (\mathrm {s}) \rightarrow \mathrm {C d} (\mathrm {s}) + \mathrm {Z n} ^ {2 +} (\mathrm {a q})$ Stage 4 The solid cadmium is filtered off and the pure zinc sulfate solution is electrolysed.
